review.publication_scope: Public organizational/facility facts and source/format metadata only; personal contacts and swimmer/race records excluded.
review.limitations: Listings do not establish current operation. Facilities remain source-scoped across USA Swimming club finder locations, USA Swimming national pool measurement certifications (2020 & 2022 editions, deduplicated and cleaned of line-wrap artifacts), Potomac Valley Swimming venue directory, Hawaiian Swimming LSC venue directory, Adirondack Swimming water-depth table, Pacific Northwest Swimming host venues, 20 USMS LMSC Places-to-Swim directories, and 9 flagship U.S. summer swim league pool directories. No terrain elevations or race-to-venue joins are inferred in the public snapshot without explicit source evidence. Canada pass 01 adds Swimming Canada club-listed addresses, Swim Alberta/Ontario/Manitoba club-listed training facilities, Swim Alberta approved competition pools (course length only where the note names it) and StatCan ODRSF pool-type records (including wading pools and water-play sites) as source-reported locations. usms_nationwide.identity: Source club GUIDs; location rows scoped to document hash, club ID and row position; no physical pool deduplication.

review.school_breadth: Thirty-two school-source states imported (8,695 listings), plus three states affirmatively verified as non-sponsoring (SD, TN, VT). Includes FL (938), WA (241), OK (127), CT boys+girls (179), NE (82), AR (72), NV (68), ND boys+girls (35). No state completeness, activity verification, cross-provider joins or inferred pool links.
review.regional_expansion: Seventeen cached source receipts independently checked; four school PDFs and the 2025 PNA directory visually reviewed. Regional club/workout-group source universes are not deduplicated against national finders. Withheld unsupported single city/website values; published source abbreviations do not create cross-provider joins.
review.site_access: Four blocked-source browser dispositions reported separately from automation: three public pages accessible, one extension permission gap. Minimal ledger preserves original status/protection observations. USMS results index is a browser-reviewed links directory, not imported results.
review.ghsa_participation: Official GHSA 2024-25 participation survey pp.37-53. All positive swimming rows: 261 boys and 264 girls, and participant-column sums matched published p.53 totals. Positive participation does not establish an independent full team or current operation. No contacts, athlete names or participant counts projected. Source names preserved; one intra-word line wrap visually joined. Raw PDF local; no redistribution license asserted.
review.naia_and_lsc_recon: Added 54 NAIA 2026 championship qualifier varsity listings (26 men, 28 women matching published denominators), 19 Adirondack Swimming LSC registered clubs, and cataloged 12 high-altitude/regional LSC and USMS SCM result archives.
